notes.title: BREAKFALL September Update V 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Dear Community, Update 1.0.4 is now available and contains changes in the game mechanics which are listed as follows

Most important Update Notes - Version 1.0.4

- Added new level "Industrial Complex"

- Added new type of NPC

- Added new weapons

- Added new sound effects

- Refined character movement

- Added new obstacle movement



 Most important Bug Fixes - Version 1.0.3

- Fixed a bug where climbing obstacles didnt work as intended

There are more minor bug-fixes

notes.title: BREAKFALL August Update V 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Dear Community, Update 1.0.3 is now available and contains changes in the game mechanics which are listed as follows  



Most important Update Notes - Version 1.0.3

- Added Radioactive Zones together with a Geiger Counter in the HUD

- Added radioactively contaminated items

- Added new workshop 'Decontaminate Station"

- Added new sound effects

- Updated weather effects

- Updated Item loot balancing

- Updated Sound Effects for certain Items

- Refined Fights with AI enemies

- Added war background atmosphere

- Added a war atmosphere cycle throughout game loop with a "nuclear highlight"

- Added a Geiger Counter HUD Effect

- Added Quicktime-Event "Evade" during melee combat fights

- Added Character Skill "Bouncer" where a character auto-evades and has more powerful punches during close combat

- Added WASD Movement during Place-Actor 



 Most important Bug Fixes - Version 1.0.3

- Fixed a bug where bear trap placement didn't work as intended

- Fixed a bug where Interaction was not certainly aborted while fighting

- Fixed a bug where Camera movement didn't work properly while placing a building object

- Fixed a bug where walking through unlocked door was not possible

- Fixed a bug where interaction was aborted

- Fixed a bug where ledge-mantling did not work as intended 



There are many more bug-fixes, but these are the most important ones

notes.title: BREAKFALL July Update V 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Dear Community, Update 1.0.2 is now available and contains changes in the game mechanics which are listed as follows



Update Notes - Version 1.0.2 


- Updated UI for "Ending/Completion"-Screen.

- Updated logic for deadly scenarios

- Updated camera movement for smoother experience

- Updated Level "Apartment Building"  

- New "Goals"-Mechanic added in HUD for local and global ingame goals  

- New "Goal" on Level "Apartment Building"  

- Added new sound effects  

- Added new character movement and animation behaviour according to attribute values (like tiredness, sickness, woundness)

notes.title: BREAKFALL June Update V 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Dear Community, Update 1.0.1 is now available and contains changes in the game mechanics which are listed as follows


Update Notes - Version 1.0.1

- Added Item Chestlight

- Added Mechanic to wear Item Chestlight

- Created Effects Bar in HUD to display different Toggleable Items and Character Effects

- Added Item Bear Trap

- Added Mechanic to place Bear Trap / Player can be trapped too.

- Updated certain Character profiles and models

- Added Item Grenade

- Updated Crafting Tables to craft new items

- Added Item & Mechanics for Gas Mask

- Added new Characters

- Refined the Animation System & added new animations

- Added Localization for German / Chinese / Russian / Japanese
